newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Power NZ recommends acceptance of Utilicorp offer.
newsitem.headline: Power NZ recommends acceptance of Utilicorp offer.

text.p: Power New Zealand directors on Monday advised shareholders to accept the takeover offer from Utilicorp NZ, a subsidiary of Utilicorp United Inc .
Utilicorp NZ is bidding for up to five percent of Power NZ, or 7,573,511 shares, at NZ$8.00/share.
"While any decision to accept this offer is entirely up to individual shareholders, you directors recommend that those wishing to sell should accept the offer from Utilicorp NZ.
"Utilicorp NZ fully supports Power NZ's continuing independence and strategic direction," the directors told shareholders.
